title: Canonical inventory ledger quantity, correction gate, and tested forward rollback

acceptanceCriteria.description: Inventory quantity is owned by immutable signed movements and the backend read model; routes and React render backend inventoryQuantity and stockStatus without owning balance truth.
Additive preparation and destructive cutover remain separate, repeatable, and fail closed when identity, immutability, nonzero movement, or exact legacy-to-ledger parity is absent.

A tested emergency forward rollback recreates the legacy cache from the immutable ledger, restores prior-runtime insert compatibility only for identified movements, tolerates replay, and preserves ledger immutability.
The correction packet is regenerated from the canonical read-only plan at the exact implementation SHA, SHA-verifies its CSV, and exposes no apply mode.
PS-462 is reserved in the repository ticket ledger, while historical ps-439-inventory aliases are documented as compatibility breadcrumbs and advisory-lock PS-439 is unchanged.

Strict typecheck, production frontend build, all 49 source-of-truth gates, inventory kill switch, shipped/cancelled locks, Print Queue recovery, and sync checkpoint regressions pass without live side effects.

Production movement and cutover are not authorized: the current read-only plan still has 49 mismatches requiring 49 append-only movements totaling +1,000, and production is missing the additive 0073 identity and immutability surface.
The numbered 0073 and 0074 files are outside drizzle/meta/_journal.json, so production sequencing needs an explicit, separately approved migration mechanism and operator runbook.

canonicalOwners: src/services/inventory-stock-math.ts owns signed ledger-derived quantity reads
drizzle/0073_inventory_quantity_sot.sql and drizzle/0074_inventory_quantity_cutover.sql own ordered schema preparation and cutover

oldOwners.delegatesTo: inventory_ledger sum after approved phase-2 cutover; recreated only for emergency prior-runtime compatibility
backend inventoryQuantity and stockStatus DTO fields
read-only reconciliation plus separately approved append-only movements

wrappers.delegatesTo: inventory movement, quantity read-model, and reconciliation owners
buildInventoryReconciliationPlan and a read-only schema preflight

sotBypass.details: The signed ledger remains canonical. The emergency cache is rebuilt from that ledger under maintenance and only supports a prior runtime; the rollback never edits ledger history or becomes normal runtime truth.

evidence.proves: PGlite applies both rollout phases, composes concurrent signed movements, deduplicates replay, applies append-only correction, removes the cache, and runs the emergency forward rollback twice.
Invalid phase order, mismatched balances, unidentified legacy writes, and immutable-ledger mutations fail closed; the rollback cannot replace the normal pre-cutover guard.
The forward rollback is idempotent, derives compatibility quantities from the ledger, accepts identified prior-runtime movements, and preserves exact cache-to-ledger parity.

evidence.command: npm run inventory:correction-packet:prepare && npm run inventory:reconcile:dry-run
evidence.proves: The ignored PS-462 packet at reviewed SHA a80fcdea has plan d62ccdab, 49 rows, +1,000 units, and CSV SHA f3574469. The aggregate also reports 33,193 missing movements, 189 negative balances, and 1,287 billing-display mismatches. No apply mode or production DML ran.
Two Playwright tests render the backend-owned inventory tuple and verify no real postage or marketplace host is contacted.

evidence.command: npm run test:audit-runtime-schema-readiness through npm run test:sot-guard-pack; inspect drizzle/meta/_journal.json
evidence.proves: Runtime DDL is absent and readiness owns the 0073 frontier. The handwritten 0073/0074 files are not journal entries, so filename-only production sequencing is not assumed.
All 49 mandatory architecture, authorization, durable-worker, lifecycle, billing, inventory, and safety gates pass.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass at the reviewed SHA.
The production frontend bundle builds successfully with 2,989 modules transformed.

evidence.command: npm run test:inventory-auto-deduct && npm run test:order-editable-lockdown && npm run test:ps-444-print-queue-recovery && npm run test:ps-409-status-catchup-backlog
evidence.proves: Inventory auto-deduction remains kill-switch protected, shipped/cancelled locks remain active, and Print Queue plus sync reliability regressions stay green.

evidence.command: read-only Trello inventory plus rg -n 'PS-439|PS-462' docs/ps-tickets/ps-ledger.md docs/ps-tickets/ps-462-inventory-quantity-rollout.md
evidence.proves: Trello shows PS-446 through PS-461 occupied and the inventory/advisory-lock PS-439 collision. Repository and branch searches found PS-462 unused, so the local ledger reserves it for inventory without mutating Trello.

The candidate contains the ledger-only rollout, migration split, test-fixture repair, PS-462 identity, read-only correction generator, and emergency forward rollback. No production movement, migration, push, or deployment is included.

verification.command: npm run test:inventory-source-of-truth && npm run test:sot-guard-pack

migrations.rollbackPlan: Stop API and worker inventory writes, set INVENTORY_AUTO_DEDUCT=false, apply the emergency forward rollback in one transaction, deploy prior compatible runtime SHA 0767ffb8be805da51b335528c466b2f487c7af0b, verify stock_qty equals the immutable ledger, then reopen traffic. Correction rollback is append-only inverse movement only.

rollback.strategy: Use ops/rollback/ps-462_inventory_quantity_forward_rollback.sql only after phase 2 and while writes are stopped. It recreates and ledger-populates compatibility columns, preserves immutable triggers, admits only deterministic legacy identities, and is followed immediately by the prior runtime. Never update, delete, or truncate ledger history.

liveVerification.reason: Only production read-only reconciliation and schema preflight were run. No correction, migration, Render deployment, commit-parity check, or post-deploy health verification is authorized or complete.

caveats.description: Production has 49 mismatches. The ignored packet proposes 49 append-only movements totaling +1,000 and requires a fresh plan-hash check plus explicit movement approval.
caveats.followUpTask: Review the PS-462 correction manifest and separately authorize or reject the exact append-only production movement transaction.

caveats.followUpTask: Approve and apply additive 0073 under a reviewed migration procedure before any correction movement.
